- Reminder from TechMarkt Online GmbH, due Wed 30 Sep 2026: 94.99 € [item:itm_c05nsrmyz6av].

- Parking warning fee to the city treasury, due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_w1ny8kz9kmwt]. The amount is only in the letter text, where it reads 30.00 €, so please check it against the paper letter.

**Do not pay yet:** The broadcasting fee demand of 254.35 € from "Rundfunk-Beitragsservice Zahlungszentrale" shows scam signs [item:itm_ngh7a5vr7x4j]. These include hidden text, a 48-hour pressure deadline, and bank details that differ from those used before. Don't pay it until you have checked with the official Beitragsservice, using contact details you already know. A genuine sender whose bank details changed would show the same signs.
